finding.title: The shipped wrapper pair duplicates ~2,400 lines across audit/remediate with no shared module - and the duplication ratchet does not scan wrapper/ at all
finding.summary: Five wrapper file pairs are near-copies: normalizing only the tool name, diff between wrapper/audit-code-wrapper-install-hosts.mjs (1,187 lines) and wrapper/remediate-code-wrapper-install-hosts.mjs (1,223 lines) is 178 changed lines (~85% identical); opencode pair 110, legacy 36, install-renderers 21, io 14. Both install-hosts files ship in the published package (package.json files includes wrapper/**), so every installer fix - marker handling, permission asserts, manifest writes, the Antigravity/OpenCode/Codex host blocks - must be applied twice and can drift silently. The existing drift-stopper cannot catch it: check:dup runs jscpd over 'src scripts tests' only (.jscpd.json, gitignore:true), so the largest duplicated surface in the shipped artifact is outside the ratchet's scope. Improvement: single-source the pair into one parameterized wrapper core (tool name, MCP agent key, permission-assert fn, install dir) with the two bins as thin instantiations, and add wrapper/ to the jscpd scan so the class is watched wherever it recurs.
